pdf_export_guide.pdf_title: DATA INTEROPERABILITY & EHI DATA EXPORT GUIDE

scope_statement.health_data: Health Data stored in MDNet v10.0 which has been captured by the practice or received electronically related to a medical record.
scope_statement.financial_data: Financial data stored in MDNet v10.0 which has been captured by the practice or received electronically related to a medical record. This includes claim, adjudication and all other related data sets.

export_methods.name: FHIR APIs
export_methods.description: Standard FHIR R4 API with SMART on FHIR authorization. Supports US Core resource types and Bulk Data export.

export_methods.name: C-CDA R2.1 bulk or single export
export_methods.description: Authorized users can set up one-time or scheduled tasks for FULL SET, Partial date-based, Partial Segment-based, or incremental updates.

export_methods.name: CSV full data set export
export_methods.description: Detailed export of health, activity and financial data for specific patient or all patients. Data dictionary referenced at https://emr.ehiconnect.com/docs/ (URL returns 404).

export_methods.name: HL7 2.x/3.x ADT
export_methods.description: Real-time updates on new patient chart creation, chart updates across demographics and payer information.

export_methods.name: HL7 2.x SIU
export_methods.description: Real-time updates on patient appointments, edits, cancellations and check-in.

export_methods.name: HL7 2.x DFT
export_methods.description: Listed for financial transactions but description repeats SIU text (apparent copy-paste error in PDF).
export_methods.note: Copy-paste error: DFT description matches SIU description verbatim

export_methods.name: JSON-based exchange for scanned documents
export_methods.description: Exchange of all scanned documents, faxes across all or specific folders. JSON provides segments for patient identification and BASE-64 encoded document content.

export_methods.name: EDI 837P and 835 Claims files
export_methods.description: Continuous feed of claim EDI 837P and EDI 835 files created for the practice.

optional_service.name: Announce & Deliver
optional_service.description: Optional data exchange service using C-CDA R2.1 with incremental updates
transport_methods: Web Service Hosted by Enable Healthcare
